title: Gang Garrison 2
tagline: Not shipped: the assets are Valve's Team Fortress 2 and Cave Story's.
summary: This is an assessment folder, not a port. Gang Garrison 2's code is MPL-2.0, but its nine classes, several maps and two music tracks are Valve's Team Fortress 2, and its secret class is Cave Story's Quote/Curly.

The project ships only games whose code and every asset are free for any use including commercial, compatible with GPL-3.0+, and without trademark problems; those assets are not. LICENSE.md records the file-by-file assessment, and re/ganggarrison/NOTES.md has the sources and raw findings.
